### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

### Target Module
- [ ] Android App
- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] ML Risk Engine
- [ ] Data Pipeline
- [ ] Documentation / CI

### Motivation / User Value
Why is this feature needed? Who benefits and how does it advance personal safety?

### Proposed Design / Technical Approach
Describe how this feature should be implemented, adhering to SafePath AI's architectural principles:
- 100% Java + XML for Android (no Kotlin/Compose).
- On-device voice processing only (zero cloud audio streaming).
- Emergency alerts dispatch exclusively to user-verified contacts.

### Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you considered.
